title: DongbaMIE: A Multimodal Information Extraction Dataset for Evaluating Semantic Understanding of Dongba Pictograms
benchmark_measurement: Semantic understanding and information extraction (objects, actions, relations, attributes) from the pictographic script of the Dongba religion.
findings: Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle significantly to extract semantic information from Dongba pictographs, a script deeply rooted in Dongba religion. Even advanced models like GPT-4o achieved very low F1 scores (e.g., 1.60 for object extraction) in zero-shot settings. The models failed to extract complex semantics, such as relations and attributes, and made specific errors like misinterpreting symbolic features, such as reading potential human figures as a 'village god'.
